# Item

A row with media, a title, a description and actions.

<p class="odv-compstatus"><span class="odv-pill">In Brand expressive</span></p>

## When to use it

**In Brand expressive:** A short list with media and a few actions. Not for products and features; card does that.

- **Use it when:** Lists of things such as people, files or settings, each with a few actions.
- **Not when:** Records people compare cell by cell (a table).

Instead:

- [Card](./card.md): A larger unit with more content.
- [Table](./table.md): Records compared across columns.

## Why it works this way

Item looks the way it does because of 5 answers about this product. Each card is one answer, in three steps: the answer, what it decided for Item, and what would move if it changed.

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-elevation-definition"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What separates groups on the page?</b><code>elevation.definition</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Cards</div><p>Cards hold each offer.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Item</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>default</b>: Rows inside a card, which already gives the frame.</span></li></ul></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Item decision would reopen</small><p>No other answer follows from it.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-color-values"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>How saturated is the palette?</b><code>color.values</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Vivid</div><p>Vivid color is the brand.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Item</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>outline</b>: Rows on a color block, with a border so each holds its edge on vivid color.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Toggle: default</code> <code>Toggle: outline</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Item decision would reopen</small><p>and 2 answers that follow from it: <b>Two-tone</b>, <b>Brand color</b>.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-brand-q2"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>How visible is the brand in the interface?</b><code>brand.q2</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Loud</div><p>The brand is loud everywhere.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Item</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>muted</b>: A quiet fill reads as bland on a loud page; color blocks already mark each section.</span></li></ul></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">2</div><small>Item decisions would reopen</small><p>and 22 answers that follow from it: <b>Core and expressive display</b>, <b>Fine steps, so pages can set their own rhythm</b>, <b>A ratio, line heights in proportion</b>, and 19 more.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-outcomes-q2"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What is a costly mistake?</b><code>outcomes.q2</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Looking off-brand</div><p>A bland page is the costly mistake.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Item</h5><ul><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>muted</b>: A quiet fill reads as bland on a loud page; color blocks already mark each section.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: secondary</code> <code>Button: danger</code> <code>Alert: destructive</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">1</div><small>Item decision would reopen</small><p>and 1 answer that follow from it: <b>One per moment</b>.</p></div></div></section>

<section class="odv-trail" id="why-accessibility-values"><div class="odv-trail-head"><b>What is the smallest target?</b><code>accessibility.values</code></div><div class="odv-steps"><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>1</i>The answer</h5><div class="odv-answer">Touch size</div><p>Visitors come from social posts on phones.</p></div><div class="odv-step-col"><h5><i>2</i>So Item</h5><ul><li><span class="y">✓</span><span>uses <b>default</b>: Every row, at touch size: phones first.</span></li><li><span class="n">–</span><span>does not use <b>sm</b>: Phones first: no compact rows.</span></li></ul><div class="odv-also"><small>It also shapes</small> <code>Button: default</code> <code>Button: compact</code> <code>Button: icon</code> <code>Field: horizontal</code> <code>Input group: inline-end</code> <code>Toggle: default</code> <code>Toggle: sm</code></div></div><div class="odv-step-col change"><h5><i>3</i>If it changed</h5><div class="odv-big">2</div><small>Item decisions would reopen</small><p>and 1 answer that follow from it: <b>Those and pressed</b>.</p></div></div></section>

## Words

- Headlines are short and bold. Three to six words.
- Verbs that move: Join, Try, Go.
- Playful in headlines, plain in errors.
- Use: Join, Drop, Go, Love. Avoid: Synergy, Leverage, Kindly.

The labels components use, from the voice tokens:

- `content.action.commit`: Go
- `content.action.cancel`: Not now
- `content.action.destroy`: Remove
- `content.action.retry`: Try again
- `content.action.empty-action`: Explore the drop

See [Voice and tone](../voice.md) for the whole voice.

## Use it in code

```bash
npx open-ds add item
```

The component reads only component keys and semantic tokens, so it follows the brand and mode on `<html>`.
